title: Memory instruction extraction
statement: Let $A$ be a memory-augmented register program, let $l$ be one of its control states, and let $\beta$ be a Boolean. If the instruction of $A$ at $l$ is a memory instruction, then the deterministic part of $A$ at $l$ is the instruction that returns $\beta$ and halts.
hypotheses_covered: The instruction of $A$ at $l$ is a memory instruction
